t: This bronze statue of John Betjeman stands at St Pancras station. Martin Jennings made it, and it was unveiled on 12 November 2007 by Betjeman's daughter, Candida Lycett Green, and the Poet Laureate Andrew Motion. It marked the opening of St Pancras International as the Eurostar terminus. Betjeman was a poet, writer and broadcaster, and Poet Laureate from 1972 until his death. He was a passionate defender of Victorian architecture and led the campaign in the 1960s to save this station from demolition.
